Question B-001-024-003.

Why the correct answer is right: The 48 MHz to 300 MHz range causes the greatest radio-frequency (RF) energy risk because the human body absorbs RF energy most strongly in that range.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "300 MHz to 3000 MHz": This range starts above 300 MHz, while the greatest-risk range is 48 MHz through 300 MHz.
- sourceIndex 2: "Above 1500 MHz": A threshold above 1500 MHz misses the lower very-high-frequency (VHF) range where human-body absorption is strongest.
- sourceIndex 3: "3 MHz to 30 MHz": This high-frequency (HF) range sits below 48 MHz; the greatest RF-energy risk range is 48 MHz to 300 MHz.
